title: Ohio girl’s $768 lemonade stand grows into nonprofit that raises over $5 million for hospitals
summary_full: After her time at Cincinnati Children's Hospital, Payton Obert initiated a lemonade stand to assist children in distress. What started as a simple venture has evolved into Payton's Lemonade Stand, amassing over $5 million for various children's charities. The nonprofit not only supplies toys and necessary items to kids facing illness but also encourages community participation, proving that even small gestures can spark tremendous positive impacts.
